desc: Implement exact memoized DP (unopened multiset + pool + player) and build exhaustive tester N≤4, A_i≤5 with hypothesis check and pattern tables.

Analyze game structure: reduction to claiming game with pool; T' parity invariant T'=(N-2)+Σ_{claimed}(A_i-1); N=2 always Snuke; N=3 Fennec iff ∃ odd A_i; disproved "exclude two largest" hypothesis via (2,2,3)→Fennec.

Establish rigorous reduction: decisive state (k=2,P=0), mover loses; T' invariant under interleaving; Fennec wins iff T' odd; only strategic content is parity of claimed B-sum and timing of who claims.

Complete the claiming-game timing derivation analytically: who claims c_j under optimal play (pool-parity argument), and produce the exact closed-form rule consistent with all verified cases (N=1→F; N=2→S; N=3→F iff ∃ odd; (2,2,3)→F; samples 1–3→F,S,S).
Prove the fitted criterion for general N (induction on k/claims using the timing lemma).
Write the final O(N log N) solution reading stdin and printing Fennec/Snuke, with a self-check comment tracing the three samples (Fennec/Snuke/Snuke) and the (2,2,3)→Fennec case.
